name: sshi_zener
rationale: The reference FBR design fails due to efficiency losses (S2, S4) and lack of overvoltage protection (S3). I am implementing a Parallel-SSHI (Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor) topology to invert the piezoelectric capacitance voltage at each half-cycle, significantly increasing the harvested energy to meet vavg requirements. I've added a DZ33 Zener diode as a clamp on the output node to prevent vout from exceeding 3.6 V in high-excitation conditions (S3). A larger storage capacitor is used to suppress ripple and improve settling stability (S5).
